text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British newspaper criticises U.S. stand on sanctions on Iraq.
- More calls for the withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
- Arab League secretary-general meets Iraqi envoy.
- Yemen and Iraq discuss bilateral relations.
- Iraq and Lebanon discuss health relations.
- National Assembly speaker lauds Iraq-Sudan ties.
- Russia to expand purchases of Iraqi oil.
- Zionist authorities continue their coercive policies against Palestinians in occupied territories.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Article on the dangers of American aggressive policy vis-a-vis Arab countries.
- Article on the economic benefits to be gained from the national census due later this year.
- Industry and minerals minister opens a bicycle factory.
